80

Problem Statement

Given an array of N integers, find the second largest distinct element using pointers.

Your program should:

Read N integers.

Pass the array address and N to a function named  secondLargest() .

Traverse the array using pointers.

Identify the largest and second largest distinct values.

Print the second largest element.

If no second largest distinct element exists, print  -1 .
input_spec:
First line contains N.

Second line contains N integers.
